Hi Laura,

Apologies for the short notice — as part of our DPA annual review we've got a narrower ask from our privacy team: can you share the current subprocessor roster that will process EU-origin data for our account, and an export route diagram that shows where data might leave the EU (including any temporary transit processors)?

Specifically we need: 
- A roster with vendor name, country of processing, role (telemetry, cache, observability, analytics), and whether they store logs persistently.
- Any temporary/backup processors or transit partners and the typical egress paths.
- A list of subprocessors that have onshore fallback arrangements in EU jurisdictions.

Can you get this to us by EOD Monday (we know it's tight)? If useful, we can accept a provisional inventory and then a final version. Also please flag any items that might require a DPA addendum or DocuSign acknowledgement.

Thank you — Elena
Elena Martinez

Hi all — attaching the provisional inventory we pulled from our internal roster. This is marked v3 because it includes the last week's small changes (temporary telemetry bridge).

Key flags for Finexa: 
- EdgeBridge (transit relay) — transient bursts to US analytics during heavy ingestion windows. It's not persistent storage but does handle packets in transit. See note column in the spreadsheet.
- TelemetryStore EU (onshore fallback) — located in DE and used for EU-only tenancy for customers that require residency; credentials + KMS reside in the EU. This one is covered by our standard DPA; no addendum required.
- ThirdBridge Analytics (Sanjay Rao) — processes aggregated telemetry in US; persistent logs exist for 7 days. This will likely trigger the "requires addendum" flag if Finexa requires strict EU-only processing.

I've attached: subprocessor_inventory_v3.xlsx (provisional) and a one-page export map PDF (export_route_diagram.pdf). Marissa will follow up on the CSV and the formatted diagram for your review.

Please confirm whether Finexa needs any immediate blocking actions (e.g., suspend EdgeBridge for your tenant) or whether provisional transparency is sufficient for this stage.

Kim
